title: Every inventory item links to unit cost
summary: Unit cost is first-class on stock: click any cost cell to set it, banner for ₹0 items, restock updates cost, plate cost/margin use the linked value, stock value shown per row.
highlights: Click Unit cost on any stock row to set/edit
Banner: N items missing cost + Set costs wizard
Restock: enter paid unit cost — saved on the item
Shows stock value (qty × unit cost) under each cost
